description: Research brief on any topic in one call: the best papers from ISHOB's open-licence archive, filled with a live search of 250M+ scholarly works, each with authors, year, venue, DOI and citations; abstracts only for openly licensed papers (CC0 / public domain / CC BY / CC BY-SA), metadata and link for the rest; plus a short AI synthesis citing the papers as [n]. Checked before payment: if nothing is found anywhere the answer is a free 404 'not_covered'. Paid ($0.05, x402).

include_live.description: Fill with live results from open scholarly sources when the archive has fewer papers

max_papers.description: Maximum number of papers in the brief

year_from.description: Only papers published in or after this year
